market_name: Ukraine agrees not to join NATO by December 31, 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the market move is corroborated by newswire/official statements or is isolated order flow; look at ITA and European defense names (Rheinmetall) for an initial reaction.
time_plan.1h: Compare ITA move vs broad market (SPY) to isolate defense-specific signal; check for Reuters/AP headlines on Ukraine-NATO language.
time_plan.2h: Reassess whether the probability move held; if it reversed, close thesis. Watch European defense ADRs.
time_plan.6h: Check for official Ukrainian/US/Russian statements; evaluate if de-escalation narrative is strengthening or fading.
time_plan.12h: Review full-window ITA return vs benchmark and whether a genuine peace headline materialized; log hit/miss.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability that Ukraine pledges not to join NATO would signal progress toward a Russia-Ukraine peace/ceasefire framework, since NATO non-membership is a core Russian precondition. De-escalation reduces the war-driven premium in Western defense procurement expectations, pressuring defense contractor valuations. ITA is liquid and broadly exposed to this theme.

predictions.asset: European natural gas / European equity risk

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify the probability spike is news-driven, not noise; check EUR/USD spot reaction.
time_plan.1h: Compare EUR move vs DXY to separate euro-specific strength; scan for European gas (TTF) price reaction.
time_plan.2h: Reassess if euro strength persists or mean-reverts amid other macro drivers (rates, data).
time_plan.6h: Check for confirmed diplomatic headlines; evaluate whether European equity indices (EZU) corroborate the risk-on read.
time_plan.12h: Log full-window EUR return and whether de-escalation narrative held; note FX was likely dominated by unrelated macro.

predictions.reasoning: A credible move toward Russia-Ukraine de-escalation would lower European geopolitical and energy-supply risk, modestly supporting the euro and European risk assets while easing the energy-cost drag on the eurozone. The euro (FXE) is a liquid, broadly-exposed proxy for improved European risk sentiment, though the linkage is diffuse and macro-dominated.

evidence_used: Market question: Ukraine pledging not to join NATO, framed as part of a potential peace process (Bosnia/Dayton analogy cited)
NATO non-membership is a well-documented core Russian precondition in ceasefire discussions
Defense equities carry a war-driven procurement premium that de-escalation would erode
European energy and risk premia are sensitive to Russia-Ukraine conflict intensity
uncertainty_notes: A probability move may reflect speculation or thin liquidity, not genuine leaked information
Even a Yes pledge is only one component of a broader deal that may not materialize, limiting market impact
Defense stock reaction can be muted because long-term rearmament trends (Europe) persist regardless of a single ceasefire
FX and equity proxies are dominated by macro factors (rates, inflation data) that can swamp any geopolitical signal

llm_justification.summary: A sharp upward move in the probability that Ukraine agrees not to join NATO would be read as progress toward a Russia-Ukraine peace framework (NATO non-membership being a core Russian demand). The cleanest liquid implications are modest downside for Western defense equities (ITA) as the war premium fades, and modest upside for European risk/euro (FXE) as geopolitical and energy risk eases. Both mappings are diffuse and macro-contaminated, so confidence is low-to-moderate and expected moves likely fall below the 700bps tradable threshold.
key_assumptions: A large probability move corresponds to real information about peace progress rather than noise
Markets interpret Ukraine NATO non-membership as a de-escalation signal
Defense and euro proxies retain their conventional geopolitical sensitivity over the 12h window
failure_modes: The probability move reverses or was already priced/public, producing no asset reaction
Defense stocks fail to fall because structural European rearmament demand dominates
Euro/European equities move on unrelated macro drivers, overwhelming the geopolitical signal
The pledge is symbolic and markets judge a full peace deal still unlikely, muting all reactions
Expected magnitudes stay well under 700bps, making none of these tradable
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
